issue_context.title: Bug: Can not make a archive in library
issue_context.body:
### Description

With Files built in system the archive creation fails instantly.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Add file to library
2. Create a .zip or .7z arcade
3. See operation status shows as failed (Note: Operation centre says "Compression successful" for the title)

### Steps to fix

- Get path of file in library before starting archive

### Files Version

2.4.25.0

### Windows Version

10.0.22621.1105

### Log file

[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/10522877/debug.log)
